hunks.baseline: And for the sake of those who would remain, and remember my final moments for a long time.
hunks.sol: And for the sake of those who would remain and remember my final moments for a long time.

hunks.baseline: But the Fire Dragon Pavilion members, reunited with me at last, weren’t foolish enough to miss what my condition and the heavy silence around us meant.
hunks.sol: But the Fire Dragon Pavilion members, reunited with me at last, weren’t foolish enough to miss what my condition and the heavy air around us meant.

hunks.baseline: “……Pavilion Master.”
hunks.sol: “…Pavilion Master.”

hunks.baseline: Sama Pyo stared at me blankly, then bit his lip. Song Ilseom quietly closed his eyes, and a cloudy film of tears welled in Taishan’s enormous eyes.
hunks.sol: Sama Pyo stared at me blankly, then bit his lip. Song Ilseom quietly closed his eyes, and tears clouded Taishan’s eyes, each as big as a calf’s.

hunks.baseline: She staggered across the pool of blood spread like a lake and buried her trembling head against my shoulder.
hunks.sol: She staggered across a lake-like pool of blood and buried her trembling face against my shoulder.

hunks.baseline: My ominous hunches were never wrong, but this time, they’d been the exception.
hunks.sol: My ominous hunches were never wrong, but this time was the exception.

hunks.baseline: As I confirmed they were safe, I felt my stiffened smile soften.
hunks.sol: Seeing them safe, I felt my stiff smile soften.

hunks.baseline: *Thank God. Really…… thank God.*
hunks.sol: *Thank goodness. Really… thank goodness.*

hunks.baseline: The smile on my lips now wasn’t an act anymore.
hunks.sol: The smile on my lips wasn’t an act anymore.

hunks.baseline: Gung Gibang and Cheongheoja appeared after the Fire Dragon Pavilion members.

hunks.baseline: Even the face of that wild-haired weirdo who gave me a headache every time I saw him made my heart swell with relief.
hunks.sol: Gung Gibang and Cheongheoja appeared after the Fire Dragon Pavilion members. Even the face of that wild-haired weirdo who gave me a headache every time I saw him made my chest tighten with relief.

hunks.baseline: No—maybe it wasn't Great Sir himself I was so glad to see, but the person on his back.
hunks.sol: No—maybe it wasn’t Great Sir himself I was so glad to see, but the person on his back.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t worry. He suffered a serious Internal Injury, but the Seafaring King got the stagnant blood out in time. His life isn’t in danger.”
hunks.sol: “Don’t worry. He suffered a serious internal injury, but the Seafaring King got the stagnant blood out in time. His life isn’t in danger.”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin had lost consciousness, covered in blood from head to toe, but I could trust those words a hundred times over.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin was unconscious and covered in blood from head to toe, but I could trust those words a hundred times over.

hunks.baseline: Sword Saint Mae Jonghak added in a low voice.
hunks.sol: Sword Saint Mae Jonghak added quietly, “Just like you.”

hunks.baseline: “Just like you.”
At the sincerity in his words, I parted my blood-crusted lips.
hunks.sol: Hearing the sincerity in his voice, I parted my blood-crusted lips.

hunks.baseline: Mae Jonghak had been watching me with a deeply solemn gaze. Then he smiled along with me.
hunks.sol: Mae Jonghak had been watching me with a grave expression. Then he smiled along with me.

hunks.baseline: If there’d been even the slimmest chance I could recover, Mae Jonghak would’ve answered without hesitation.
hunks.sol: If there’d been even the slimmest chance I could recover, Mae Jonghak would have answered without hesitation.

hunks.baseline: *Tell him yourself when you get the chance.*
hunks.sol: *Tell him yourself later.*

hunks.baseline: *Hyuk Mujin would be happy to hear it.*
hunks.sol: *He’ll be happy to hear it.*

hunks.baseline: But like the Slaughter Saint and Bow Saint, who stood with clenched jaws, he knew I didn’t have much time left.
hunks.sol: But like the Slaughter Saint and Bow Saint, who stood with their jaws clenched, he knew I didn’t have much time left.

hunks.baseline: “When he wakes, I’ll tell him. Every word you just said. I won’t leave a thing out.”
hunks.sol: “When he wakes, I’ll tell him exactly what you said. I won’t leave out a single word.”

hunks.baseline: “He’s so starved for praise that you can exaggerate all you like. Like……”
hunks.sol: “He’s so starved for praise that you can exaggerate all you like. For example…”

hunks.baseline: “He has what it takes to become the next Alliance Leader. Yeah. That’d make him faint with joy.”
hunks.sol: “He has what it takes to become the Alliance Leader. Yeah. That’d make him faint with joy.”

hunks.baseline: “The next Alliance Leader, you say? I have much to reflect on. To have my successor right in front of me and not recognize him.”
hunks.sol: “The next Alliance Leader, you say? I must reflect on this. My successor was right in front of me, and I failed to recognize him.”

hunks.baseline: With a firm voice, Mae Jonghak placed a hand on my shoulder.
hunks.sol: Mae Jonghak placed a hand on my shoulder, his voice firm.

hunks.baseline: “It wasn’t me who saved everyone. It was you. And them, too.”
hunks.sol: “It wasn’t me who saved everyone. It was you. And they saved themselves, too.”

hunks.baseline: Warm energy flowed from the tips of his fingers resting on my shoulder and seeped into my body.
hunks.sol: Warm qi flowed from the fingers resting on my shoulder and seeped into me.

hunks.baseline: Like the sunset, it roused my consciousness as it sank into darkness, showing me the fanatics crumbling apart and the shouts of our allies sweeping over them like a wave.
hunks.sol: Like the sunset, it roused my fading consciousness. I saw the fanatics crumbling even now and heard our allies’ shouts sweeping over them like a wave.

hunks.baseline: A roar that swallowed the fierce wind, the rain, and even the eight-character maxim.
hunks.sol: A roar that swallowed the fierce wind, the rain, and even the eight-character invocation.

hunks.baseline: —Fight back! For the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon, Jin Taekyung!
hunks.sol: —Fight back! For the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon! For Jin Taekyung!

hunks.baseline: Three forces as incompatible as water and oil had blended into one, piercing the invaders.
hunks.sol: Three forces that mixed about as well as water and oil had come together as one, driving through the invaders.

hunks.baseline: Everyone was shouting my name.
hunks.sol: All of them shouting my name.

hunks.baseline: With a desperate will and resolve that drowned out even the fanatics’ madness.
hunks.sol: Their desperate will and resolve drowned out even the fanatics’ madness.

hunks.baseline: My body trembled before I knew it.
hunks.sol: I trembled before I knew it.

hunks.baseline: As a bolt of lightning-like shiver ran up my spine, Mae Jonghak’s voice drifted into my ears.
hunks.sol: A lightning-like shiver ran up my spine, and Mae Jonghak’s voice reached my ears.

hunks.baseline: “A month ago, when I went to persuade the Seafaring King, he told me that ships couldn’t sail through a storm. The sails and oars would break, and there wouldn’t be a single glimmer of light. You wouldn’t even know which way was forward or back.”
hunks.sol: “A month ago, when I went to persuade the Seafaring King, he told me that ships couldn’t sail on a stormy night. The sails and oars would break, and without a single glimmer of light, you wouldn’t even know which way was forward or back.”

hunks.baseline: At last, the age of war had come.
hunks.sol: The age of war had come at last.

hunks.baseline: The sun of peace that had shone brilliantly over the land for more than fifty years had disappeared, and night had fallen with the dark clouds of Dark Heaven, black as pitch.
hunks.sol: The sun of peace that had shone over the land for more than fifty years had disappeared. Night had fallen with the dark clouds of Dark Heaven, deep and black as pitch.

hunks.baseline: The darkness was deep enough to shake even the two giants of the dark path, who had once fought the Hundred Thousand Demonic Disciples led by the Heavenly Demon.
hunks.sol: Deep enough to shake even the two giants of the dark path, who had once fought the Hundred Thousand Demonic Disciples led by the Heavenly Demon.

hunks.baseline: “The Green Forest Battle King said much the same thing. They were afraid of Dark Heaven’s power, and spies planted in their ranks long ago had urged them to submit in order to survive.”
hunks.sol: “The Green Forest Battle King said much the same thing. Both of them feared Dark Heaven’s power, and spies planted in their ranks long ago had urged them to submit in order to survive.”

hunks.baseline: “Yes, I did manage to persuade them. And it was easier than I expected.”
hunks.sol: “Yes, I managed to persuade them in the end. And it was easier than I expected.”

hunks.baseline: “How on earth?”
hunks.sol: “How?”

hunks.baseline: “It was just like the Great Faction War. All they needed was someone to believe in, someone who could move forward with them—a single ray of light.”
hunks.sol: “It was just like the Great Faction War. All they needed was someone they could believe in and move forward beside. A single ray of light.”

hunks.baseline: I didn’t know.
hunks.sol: I didn’t know that distant past.

hunks.baseline: That past had long since faded into the distant years.
And yet, I could still guess.
I knew what light had shone through the darkness of the Great Faction War.
hunks.sol: And yet I could guess what light had shone through the darkness of the Great Faction War.

hunks.baseline: That was probably why my eyes widened without my meaning to.
hunks.sol: That must have been why my eyes widened.

hunks.baseline: That brilliant light, which had illuminated an age of war, had disappeared long ago.
hunks.sol: The brilliant light that had illuminated that age of war had vanished long ago.

hunks.baseline: “……No way.”
hunks.sol: “…No way.”

hunks.baseline: I looked at Mae Jonghak, smiling faintly, and asked as if groaning.
hunks.sol: I looked at Mae Jonghak’s faint smile and forced out the question.

hunks.baseline: At his answer, a hot, sudden swell rose from deep in my chest.
hunks.sol: His answer sent something hot surging up from deep in my chest.

hunks.baseline: “One who goes ahead of everyone else to light the way. Someone who can bring everyone together because he isn’t bound by status or formality. That’s why you are the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon and Prince Shangshan—but before either of those, you’re a human being.”
hunks.sol: “One who goes ahead of everyone else to light the way. Someone who can bring everyone together because he isn’t bound by status or formality. The Blazing Flame Divine Dragon and Prince Shangshan—but before either of those, a human being.”

hunks.baseline: His voice, reciting the words like a poem, spread across the battlefield.
hunks.sol: His voice carried across the battlefield as though he were reciting a poem.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, countless footsteps trampled through the pools of blood left by the invaders, and dazzling spears and blades lit up the darkness.
hunks.sol: Countless feet trampled through the pools of blood left by the invaders, and dazzling spears and blades lit the darkness.

hunks.baseline: The darkness was fading.
hunks.sol: The darkness was fading. So was the flame inside me.

hunks.baseline: The flame inside me was fading, too.
Everyone in Xining was still screaming my name until their voices broke.
hunks.sol: Everyone in Xining was still calling my name at the top of their lungs.

hunks.baseline: As if mourning my death, just around the corner.
hunks.sol: As if mourning my death before it had even come.

hunks.baseline: Mae Jonghak said much the same thing as Cheongpung had, and cried in the same way. Then he had no choice but to turn away from me.
hunks.sol: Mae Jonghak said much the same thing as Cheongpung had, crying just as he had. Then he had no choice but to turn away from me.

hunks.baseline: He had the duty and responsibility to end this damn battle even a moment sooner and save as many lives as he could.
hunks.sol: He had a duty to end this damn battle even a moment sooner and save as many lives as he could.

hunks.baseline: Maybe he was sparing someone.
hunks.sol: Maybe he was also giving someone space.

hunks.baseline: Someone who stood a few steps behind me, frozen in body and spirit, silently watching everything.
hunks.sol: Someone who stood a few steps behind me, frozen in body and spirit, watching it all in silence.

hunks.baseline: But I knew better than anyone that his anger was aimed at himself.
hunks.sol: But I knew better than anyone that Jeok Cheongang’s anger was aimed at himself.

hunks.baseline: And I knew that the only help I could offer him, as his heart bled tears, was to smile.
hunks.sol: And I knew that smiling was the only thing I could do for him, when he must have been bleeding tears inside.

hunks.baseline: “……Is it that obvious?”
hunks.sol: “…Is it that obvious?”

hunks.baseline: We knew it was the only thing that might comfort each other, even a little.
hunks.sol: We both knew it was the only way we could comfort each other, even a little.

hunks.baseline: Of course, we could tell from each other’s eyes that it was forced.
hunks.sol: Of course, we could see in each other’s eyes that neither smile was real.

hunks.baseline: “No. It isn’t. When I look back, nothing ever has been.”
hunks.sol: “No. It isn’t. Looking back, nothing ever was.”

hunks.baseline: The translucent hologram window was still there in the corner of my vision, no matter which way I turned my head.
hunks.sol: The translucent hologram window stayed in the corner of my vision, no matter which way I turned my head.

hunks.baseline: “Come on. You’re always dismissing him as a drunken monk.”
hunks.sol: “Come on. You’re always calling him a damn monk and dismissing everything he says.”

hunks.baseline: “This time, I’ll choose to believe him.”
hunks.sol: “This time, I intend to believe him.”

hunks.baseline: “……There has to be an afterlife for us to meet again.”
hunks.sol: “…There has to be an afterlife for us to meet again.”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t mind if it takes a long time. Just try to take as long as you can.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t mind if it’s a long time before we meet. Come as late as you can.”

hunks.baseline: “It’ll take quite a while regardless. There are too many people I need to kill.”
hunks.sol: “It’ll take quite a while regardless. There are a lot of bastards I need to kill.”

hunks.baseline: “Now that you mention it, you’re right. You know, that gives me an idea.”
hunks.sol: “Now that you mention it, you’re right. That gives me an idea.”

hunks.baseline: “Once you’ve killed those sons of bitches, I’ll be waiting in the afterlife. I’ll kill them one more time.”
hunks.sol: “Once you’ve killed those motherfuckers, I’ll be waiting in the afterlife to kill them again.”

hunks.baseline: “Unacceptable.”
hunks.sol: “No.”

hunks.baseline: “You only need to beat them to within an inch of their lives. Then we can kill them together once more.”
hunks.sol: “Just beat them until they’re about to die. Then we can kill them together one more time.”

hunks.baseline: “I suppose I was close to a natural disaster.”
hunks.sol: “More of a natural disaster, I’d say.”

hunks.baseline: “……Yeah. You must be exhausted.”
hunks.sol: “…Yeah. You must be exhausted.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m sorry, but could I ask you for one favor?”
hunks.sol: “I’m sorry, but could I ask you for a favor?”

hunks.baseline: “I have a family. They’re not here. So I don’t think I’ll get to see them now.”
hunks.sol: “I have family. They aren’t here, so I don’t think I’ll get to see them now.”

hunks.baseline: “If you happen to meet them someday—though I know that probably won’t happen—could you tell them how I’m doing?”
hunks.sol: “If you ever meet them—though you probably won’t—could you tell them what happened to me?”

hunks.baseline: “What must this old man do to reach the realm of immortals where you once stayed?”
hunks.sol: “What must this old man do to reach the realm of immortals where you stayed?”

hunks.baseline: Beyond my blurring vision, I saw Jeok Cheongang crying like a child.
hunks.sol: Through my blurring vision, I could see Jeok Cheongang crying like a child.

hunks.baseline: “Please…… can’t you stay alive?”
hunks.sol: “Please… can’t you stay alive?”

hunks.baseline: As the darkness swept toward me, I answered.
hunks.sol: As darkness closed in, I answered.

hunks.baseline: And then the entire world surrounding me closed.
hunks.sol: And then the entire world around me closed.
